checks.text: The page shows the heading "EPUB Reader" and the text "No book loaded".

Clicking the button "Choose file" and selecting a file named "test.epub" with content "Hello World" loads the book; the page shows the text "test.epub" and the PagedReader displays the text "Hello World" on page 1.
After loading "test.epub", clicking the button "Next page" advances to page 2; the progress indicator shows "Page 2 of 5" and the PagedReader displays the text for page 2.
After loading "test.epub" and navigating to page 3, clicking the button "Add bookmark" adds a bookmark; the bookmarks list shows an item with the text "Page 3" and the text "No bookmarks" is gone.
After adding a bookmark on page 3, clicking the button "Delete Page 3" in the bookmarks list removes that item; the bookmarks list shows the text "No bookmarks".
After loading "test.epub", clicking the button "Export page" copies the text "Hello World" to the clipboard and shows the message "Copied page text".

After loading "test.epub" and navigating to page 2, clicking the select labelled "Font size" and choosing "Large" changes the PagedReader text size; the PagedReader displays the same text "Hello World" but with a larger font size.
After loading "test.epub" and navigating to page 3, reloading the page still shows the text "test.epub", the PagedReader displays the text for page 3, and the progress indicator shows "Page 3 of 5".
Reload keeps the loaded book "test.epub" and the bookmark on page 3; after reload, the bookmarks list shows an item with the text "Page 3".
